phases.objective: Expose bounded pressure evidence, domain classification, and deterministic review plans without database mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Pressure intelligence collector and admin GET route
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The system returns deterministic pressure evidence and blocked/ready-for-review plans with no write or execution authority.
steps: Read bounded information_schema table metrics through SELECT-only queries.
Normalize capacity, growth, largest tables, policy coverage, and reclaim estimates.
Classify TTL, supersession, lineage-sensitive, and unknown resources.
Resolve policy metadata or return a fail-closed blocker.
Fingerprint a candidate plan after canonical sorting.
assertions: Missing capacity quota is reported as capacity_unknown.
Candidate ordering does not change plan fingerprint.
Unknown policy and wildcard resource URIs are blocked.
The output always carries will_write=false, will_execute=false, and no_delete=true.
The collector SQL is SELECT-only and secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Integrate pressure evidence with durable read-only snapshots and policy coverage telemetry without enabling mutation.
Validate unknown database outcomes, concurrent writers, policy refresh, and domain preservation invariants before mutation work.
Run a non-production observation canary and compare pressure/growth evidence against baseline.
Require production readback, security, performance, and owner evidence before any later mutation PR.
